steps.text: Go to your room and sit down at the desk.
Open the bill of fare, put {dish} on it, and put it up.
Go down to the kitchen and get a pot of {dish} going on the {station}.
Unbolt the front door. The inn is open.
A {guest} has come in and sat down. Walk over and say hello.
They'd like {dish}. Ladle a bowl at the {station} once the pot's ready.
Carry the {dish} over to the {guest}'s table.
Paid! While the {guest} eats, watch their face: it says how the {dish} went down.
Back at the desk, buy a {thing} under Equipment. The carter brings it in the morning.
